name: 4-Chlorokynurenine
aliases: 4-Cl-KYN, AV 101, AV-101, AV101, L-4-chlorokynurenine, L-4-Chlorokynurenine, L-4-Cl-KYN
summary: L-4-Chlorokynurenine (4-Cl-KYN; developmental code name AV-101) is an orally active small molecule prodrug of 7-chlorokynurenic acid, a NMDA receptor antagonist. It was investigated as a potential rapid-acting antidepressant.

pharmacology.text: 4-Chlorokynurenine penetrates the blood–brain barrier via the large neutral amino acid transporter 1. In the central nervous system it is converted to 7-chlorokynurenic acid by kynurenine aminotransferase in astrocytes. Most of its therapeutic potential is believed to occur via 7-chlorokynurenic acid which inhibits the glycine co-agonist site of NMDA receptors.

uses.text: It was investigated as a potential rapid-acting antidepressant. A phase II clinical trial failed to show any effect over placebo in alleviating treatment-resistant depression.
